content:
Completing my internship at BeIN Legal LLP, Indore marks another meaningful milestone in my legal journey.

Over the past few weeks, I had the privilege of learning in an environment that constantly encouraged curiosity, responsibility, and professional growth. I am sincerely grateful to Ankur Tiwari Sir and Vishwajeet Ahirwar Sir for believing in my potential and giving me this opportunity. Their guidance, patience, and trust made this experience truly enriching.

What made this internship even more memorable was the warm and supportive work culture they have built. From the very beginning, every intern was made to feel comfortable, valued, and encouraged to ask questions without hesitation. Such an environment not only strengthens legal understanding but also builds confidence and inspires continuous learning.

During my internship, I had the opportunity to work on a variety of legal assignments, including:
• Compliance-related work
• Exposure to Intellectual Property Rights (IPR) matters
• Drafting legal notices and IPR objection replies
• Attending Lok Adalat proceedings
• Reading and analysing case files, and preparing concise notes for seniors
• Conducting legal research on leading judgments and case laws
• Went to Collectorate and observed the proceedings associated with SARFAESI Act

Each assignment strengthened my research, drafting, analytical, and practical legal skills while giving me valuable insight into the professional responsibilities of legal practice.

I am thankful to everyone at BeIN Legal for helping me with their guidance, encouragement, and for making this learning experience so memorable. I look forward to carrying these lessons with me as I continue to grow in the legal profession.

comment: Internships become truly valuable when exposure to files and proceedings is paired with understanding the reasoning behind decisions. That habit of connecting theory with practice shapes stronger legal professionals.
